hornbill: A rhinoceros hornbill perched sideways on a bare branch. A large bird with GLOSSY BLACK plumage, a WHITE LOWER BELLY, and a LONG WHITE TAIL crossed by ONE BROAD BLACK BAND near its end. Its bill is huge, pale cream and curved gently downward, and sitting ON TOP of that bill is a SEPARATE STRUCTURE: a thick ORANGE-AND-RED CASQUE shaped like a horn that sweeps UPWARD AND CURLS BACK toward the bird's forehead, the way a rhinoceros horn curves up off a snout. The casque is a distinct block of orange-red sitting above the pale bill, not a flat ridge and not the same colour as the bill. Bare skin around a pale eye
oarfish: A single oarfish shown as a LONG NARROW SILVER RIBBON, drifting vertically and curving in a slow S. Picture a strip of silver foil or a belt: it is many times longer than it is deep, and FLAT. Its body TAPERS SMOOTHLY TO A THIN POINT at the back with NO TAIL FIN WHATSOEVER - no fan, no fork, no crescent, no spread of rays at the end. The body simply narrows away to nothing like the tip of a ribbon. A crimson fin of short rays runs the whole length of its back. A TALL CREST OF LONG RED PLUMES rises from the top of its small blunt head. Two long red oar-shaped fins trail from just behind the head. Silvery skin with faint dark flecks, one large dark eye
flyingsquirrel: A flying squirrel gliding, seen from above with all four limbs stretched out sideways. Between its wrist and its ankle on EACH SIDE is a FLAP OF FURRY SKIN stretched taut like a kite or a parachute - this is loose body skin, continuous with its flanks and COVERED IN THE SAME FUR as its back. It has NO WINGS: no feathers, no bat wing, no finger bones spreading the skin, no membrane joined to the tail. Just furred skin filling the gap between front leg and back leg. Soft grey-brown fur, a cream belly, enormous round black eyes, and a broad flat bushy tail held out straight behind
sundacolugo: A Sunda colugo gliding, seen from above with all four limbs stretched out sideways. A FLAP OF FURRY SKIN runs from its neck to its wrists to its ankles AND ALL THE WAY TO THE TIP OF ITS TAIL, making one continuous kite-shaped sheet with the animal in the middle. This skin is COVERED IN THE SAME MOTTLED GREY-GREEN LICHEN-PATTERNED FUR as its back. It has NO WINGS: no feathers, no bat wing, no long finger bones. Large forward-facing dark eyes, a small blunt face, mottled grey fur flecked with pale spots
nakedmolerat: A naked mole rat, a pink WRINKLED HAIRLESS rodent with loose baggy skin and NO FUR AT ALL except a few scattered whiskers. Its eyes are TINY BLACK DOTS, almost sealed shut. TWO ENORMOUS BUCK TEETH stick out IN FRONT OF ITS CLOSED LIPS, one pair up and one pair down, protruding right outside the mouth. A blunt cylindrical body, short splayed pink legs with long claws, a thin tapering tail. Wrinkled greyish-pink skin
molequeen: A naked mole rat QUEEN, a pink hairless wrinkled rodent that is MUCH LONGER AND FATTER than an ordinary mole rat, her body STRETCHED AND SWOLLEN in the middle with pregnancy so the segments between her ribs are visibly pulled apart. She lies stretched out on her side. NO FUR, tiny black dot eyes, two enormous buck teeth protruding outside her lips, short splayed pink legs, a thin tail. Loose wrinkled greyish-pink skin, a heavy sagging belly with rows of teats
baskingshark: A basking shark filter-feeding, seen in side profile with its mouth open. THE MOUTH IS THE WHOLE POINT: it opens into a VAST SMOOTH ROUND CAVERN as wide and as tall as the shark's entire head, a hollow circular opening like the mouth of a barrel or a bucket, GAPING FAR WIDER THAN ANY NORMAL SHARK'S JAW. Inside there are NO TEETH AT ALL - not one tooth, no fangs, no serrations, no jagged rim - only soft pale feathery combs. Behind the mouth, FIVE GILL SLITS SO LONG THEY NEARLY MEET OVER THE TOP OF ITS BACK AND UNDER ITS THROAT, wrapping the head in rings like stacked collars. A short blunt conical snout, tiny eyes, a heavy grey-brown body, a crescent tail. NOT a great white, NOT a hunting shark, NO teeth
frilledshark: A frilled shark, an EEL-LIKE shark with a long slender brown body curving in loose coils. ITS HEAD IS NOT A NORMAL SHARK'S HEAD: it is BROAD AND FLATTENED LIKE AN EEL'S OR A SNAKE'S, with a BLUNT SQUARED-OFF SNOUT and the MOUTH OPENING RIGHT AT THE VERY FRONT TIP OF THE FACE rather than underneath it - there is no overhanging pointed snout above the jaw at all. The wide terminal mouth is lined with small three-pronged needle teeth. Behind the head, SIX PAIRS OF RUFFLED FRILLY GILL SLITS with loose fringed edges, the first pair meeting under the throat like a collar. Small round eyes set far forward, a long tapering tail
rattlesnake: A rattlesnake coiled with its head raised. At the VERY END OF ITS TAIL, PHYSICALLY JOINED TO IT, is a RATTLE: a chain of five or six dry interlocking horny segments, each slightly smaller than the last, forming one solid tapering stack that is ATTACHED DIRECTLY TO THE TIP OF THE TAIL AND TOUCHING IT. The rattle must be part of the snake and connected to its body - NOT floating, NOT separated by a gap, NOT hovering in the air nearby. The tail is raised so the rattle is clearly visible. A thick muscular tan body with dark brown diamond blotches edged in cream, a broad triangular head, vertical pupils, heat pits
potbellypig: A pot-bellied pig standing on four legs in side view, a small stocky domestic pig with a DEEPLY SAGGING BELLY that hangs down and almost brushes the ground, a SWAYED DIPPED BACK curving downward in the middle, short stumpy legs, and a broad flat upturned snout. Small upright ears, tiny dark eyes, a short straight tail. Black and pink mottled skin with sparse coarse bristles, heavy jowls, deep skin folds along its flanks
highlandcow: A Highland cow standing on EXACTLY FOUR LEGS in side view, one head, one tail. A stocky long-bodied cattle breed COVERED IN VERY LONG SHAGGY WAVY GINGER-ORANGE HAIR that hangs down over its whole body in heavy curtains. A THICK FRINGE OF HAIR COMPLETELY COVERS ITS EYES so only the black nose shows. Two long horns sweep out SIDEWAYS from the head and then curve gently upward at the tips. Short sturdy legs mostly hidden by hanging hair, a tufted tail. A calm heavy animal with a correct four-legged cattle body
whiterhino_c: A white rhino calf standing on four legs in side view, a young rhinoceros in PALE WARM GREY, LIGHT ALL OVER LIKE WET CEMENT, evenly and softly lit with NO BLACK, NO DARK PATCHES, NO HEAVY SHADOWS AND NO DARK BLOTCHES anywhere on its skin. Any shading is only a slightly deeper grey. A wide flat square upper lip for grazing, a broad head held low, small round ears with tufted rims, thick sturdy legs, a smooth barrel body, and only a small blunt bump where its horn will grow. Bright and clean and pale
blackrhino_c: A black rhino calf seen from a THREE-QUARTER FRONT ANGLE, its head turned toward the viewer and its body angled away, so both the face and one full flank are visible - NOT a flat side-on profile. A young rhinoceros in soft mid-grey, evenly lit, with a POINTED PREHENSILE HOOKED UPPER LIP for browsing, a small narrow head, tubular ears, thick short legs, a rounded body, and only a small bump where its horn will grow
walrus_c: A walrus calf lying on its belly, a young walrus with THICK WRINKLED CINNAMON-BROWN SKIN in loose folds. ITS MOUTH HAS NO TUSKS AT ALL - absolutely no tusks, no ivory, no white points, nothing protruding from its mouth, because a walrus calf grows none for two years. Just a smooth rounded whiskery muzzle with a dense moustache of stiff pale bristles. Small dark eyes, a heavy rounded body, short broad flippers
bristlenosepleco: A bristlenose pleco, a flat-bottomed armoured suckermouth catfish resting on the substrate in side view. Its body is BROAD AND FLATTENED, widest at the head and tapering back to the tail, plated in bony armour and coloured DARK BROWN-BLACK COVERED ALL OVER IN A DENSE NETWORK OF FINE PALE CREAM SQUIGGLES AND VERMICULATED MAZE-LIKE LINES. A TALL FAN-SHAPED DORSAL FIN standing up high on its back, wide low pectoral fins spread flat, a downward-facing round sucker mouth underneath. A CLUSTER OF SHORT FLESHY BRANCHED TENTACLES sprouts from the front of its snout like a small bushy beard. Bulging pale-ringed eyes on top of a flat head
slothbear: A sloth bear standing FIRMLY ON ALL FOUR LEGS, a four-legged bear with its belly toward the ground and its head low - it must NOT stand upright, NOT rear on its hind legs, NOT stand like a person. Shaggy unkempt jet-black fur, especially long and wild around its shoulders and neck. A PALE CREAM V-SHAPED PATCH on its chest, a long dusty-grey mobile snout with a bare pale muzzle, huge curved ivory claws, and small eyes
vervet: A vervet monkey crouching ON ALL FOURS along a branch, its weight on both hands and both feet, its back level and its long tail hanging down behind - it must NOT stand upright on two legs, NOT stand like a person, NOT walk bipedally. A slim monkey with grizzled olive-grey fur, a JET-BLACK FACE ringed by a white brow band and white cheek fur, pale hands and feet, and a long slender tail
leafcutterant: A leafcutter ant walking ON ALL SIX LEGS with its body held HORIZONTAL and low, all six feet in contact with the ground - it must NOT stand upright, NOT rear on its back legs, NOT stand like a person. Seen from the side. A reddish-brown ant with a spiny thorax, a large head with strong curved mandibles, and elbowed antennae. It carries a SINGLE CUT SEMICIRCLE OF GREEN LEAF held up above its head in its jaws like a flag or a sail
glasswing: A glasswing butterfly with its wings spread open, seen from above, alone in empty air. THE WINGS ARE COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT - clear as glass, so that empty space shows straight through the middle of each wing - and each wing is EDGED WITH A NARROW BORDER of opaque dark brown and orange-red. BOTH WINGS ARE COMPLETE AND UNOBSTRUCTED, their full outline visible from tip to tip, with nothing overlapping or merging into them. A slender dark body, long thin antennae with pale tips
leafinsect: A leaf insect seen from above, an insect whose whole body mimics a single green leaf. Its broad flat abdomen is shaped exactly like a LEAF BLADE, with a raised central midrib and fine veins branching off it, and its EDGES ARE IRREGULARLY NOTCHED AND SCALLOPED with small RUSTY-BROWN BLEMISHES AND NIBBLED-LOOKING BROWN PATCHES along the rim, as though a caterpillar had chewed it. Each of its six legs bears its own small flat leaf-shaped flange. Bright fresh green, a tiny head with short antennae. One insect only, no real leaves anywhere
stickinsect: A stick insect, ONE SINGLE EXTREMELY LONG THIN TWIG-SHAPED ANIMAL and nothing else. The animal IS the twig - it is the only object in the picture. Its body is one straight rigid brown rod, immensely long and no thicker than a pencil, with a knobbly bark-like texture. Its six legs are also thin brown rods, held pressed CLOSE ALONG ITS BODY so the whole animal reads as a single bare twig. A tiny head at one end with two long thin antennae pointing forward in line with the body. Mottled brown and grey like dead wood. One creature alone, no plant matter of any kind
firefly: A firefly at night, a small soft-bodied beetle in side view with its abdomen curled slightly downward. THE LAST TWO SEGMENTS OF ITS ABDOMEN GLOW A BRIGHT WARM YELLOW-GREEN, lit from inside like a tiny lantern, casting a gentle greenish halo around the rear of its body. A flat shield-like plate covers its head, marked with pink-red and black; its wing cases are soft brown edged with pale cream. Long thin legs, threadlike antennae, a small dark head
peacockspider: A peacock spider seen FROM THE FRONT, a tiny jumping spider raising its brightly coloured abdomen up behind it like a fan. THE ABDOMEN IS A FLAT ROUND VIVID BLUE PLATE marked with BOLD SCARLET-RED CURVED BARS AND TWO LARGE BLACK OVAL SPOTS, fringed at the sides with BRIGHT ORANGE HAIR. Below it, a fuzzy grey-white body with EIGHT EYES IN A ROW ACROSS THE FRONT OF ITS FACE - two enormous forward-facing dark central eyes flanked by smaller iridescent green ones. Two long slender legs are raised UP AND OUT to either side above its head, each banded white and dark with a white brush at the tip. Furry white legs beneath
jumpingspider: A jumping spider seen FROM THE FRONT, a small compact fuzzy spider with a squared-off face. EIGHT EYES ARRANGED IN ROWS ACROSS THE FRONT OF ITS FACE, dominated by TWO ENORMOUS ROUND FORWARD-FACING DARK EYES in the middle like headlamps, with smaller eyes flanking them and along the top of the head. A short rounded hairy body in mottled grey-brown and cream, iridescent green-blue fangs, eight sturdy furry legs held in an alert crouch, the front pair raised slightly. Bright and curious-looking
desmatosuchus: A desmatosuchus standing on four legs in side view, ONE ANIMAL WITH EXACTLY ONE TAIL AND EXACTLY FOUR LEGS. An armoured plant-eating reptile with a broad low barrel body carried on four sturdy legs, its back covered by ROWS OF RECTANGULAR BONY PLATES fitted together like paving. A PAIR OF ENORMOUS BACKWARD-CURVING SPIKES projects sideways from its SHOULDERS, longer than its own head, with smaller spikes running along its flanks. A small head with a blunt UPTURNED PIG-LIKE SNOUT. ONE SINGLE TAIL, tapering, low and armoured - one tail only, no second tail
columbianmammoth: A Columbian mammoth standing on four legs in side view. ITS TRUNK AND ITS TUSKS ARE THREE COMPLETELY SEPARATE STRUCTURES THAT DO NOT TOUCH OR MERGE: ONE SINGLE FLEXIBLE GREY TRUNK hangs down the CENTRE of its face from between the eyes to below the chin, and TWO SEPARATE IVORY-WHITE TUSKS emerge LOWER DOWN AND WIDE TO EITHER SIDE of the trunk from the upper jaw, curving forward, outward and then sweeping upward and inward at the tips. There must be a CLEAR VISIBLE GAP between the trunk and each tusk along their whole length. Sparse coarse reddish-brown hair over a huge domed-headed body, a high shoulder hump, thick pillar legs, small ears
mastodon: An American mastodon standing on four legs in side view. ITS TRUNK AND ITS TUSKS ARE THREE COMPLETELY SEPARATE STRUCTURES THAT DO NOT TOUCH OR MERGE: ONE SINGLE FLEXIBLE GREY TRUNK hangs straight down the CENTRE of its face, and TWO SEPARATE IVORY TUSKS emerge LOWER DOWN AND WIDE TO EITHER SIDE from the upper jaw, running long, thick and only GENTLY curved, almost straight forward. There must be a CLEAR VISIBLE GAP between the trunk and each tusk along their whole length. A LOW FLAT HEAD with no dome, a long low heavy-set body, shorter legs than an elephant, shaggy dark brown hair
steppebison: A steppe bison standing on EXACTLY FOUR LEGS in side view, ONE HEAD, ONE TAIL, an anatomically correct bison. A massive shaggy wild ox with a TOWERING MUSCULAR SHOULDER HUMP rising well above its hindquarters, giving its back a steep downward slope from shoulder to rump. A large low-slung head carried below the hump, a dense woolly dark brown mane and beard over the head, neck and forelegs, and shorter smooth fur over its hindquarters. TWO LONG SMOOTH HORNS sweeping outward from the sides of the skull and curving forward and up. Sturdy legs, a tufted tail
pallascat: A Pallas's cat sitting upright facing forward, a small stocky wild cat that looks far rounder and fluffier than a house cat. ITS FUR IS UNIFORMLY PALE SILVER-GREY AND SANDY-CREAM ALL OVER, EVENLY COLOURED, WITH NO DARK PATCH ANYWHERE - and in particular ITS CHEST AND THROAT ARE PLAIN PALE CREAM WITH NO DARK MARK, NO BLACK BIB, NO DARK SPLOTCH, NO INK BLOT, NO SHADOW MASS. The only dark marks anywhere are a few THIN NARROW dark bars on its flanks, two small dark stripes on each cheek, and thin rings near the tip of its tail. A very flat wide face with LOW-SET SMALL ROUNDED EARS on the sides of its head, round yellow eyes with round pupils, a dense thick coat, a short thick blunt-tipped tail
kodkod: A kodkod, a very small South American wild cat standing on four legs in side view. IT HAS EXACTLY ONE TAIL - one single tail and no more, a short thick tail with dark rings, joined to its rump at one point only. There must be NO SECOND TAIL, no forked tail, no extra tail. Warm buff-brown fur covered in small round black spots, a small rounded head with a pale muzzle and dark cheek stripes, large dark eyes, small rounded ears with pale spots behind
tasdevil: A Tasmanian devil standing on four legs in side view, drawn REALISTICALLY with natural proportions and sober naturalistic shading, NOT cute, NOT cartoonish, NOT stylised, NOT big-eyed. A stocky heavy-set marsupial the size of a small dog with coarse BLACK fur, a BROAD WHITE BAND ACROSS ITS CHEST and a second white patch on its rump. ITS MOUTH IS FIRMLY CLOSED - lips together, no teeth showing, no gape, no snarl - and its expression is calm and unbothered. A thick blunt muzzle with a pink nose, small round pink-rimmed ears, small dark eyes, short powerful legs, a thick tapering tail
sunfishmola: An ocean sunfish seen in side view. Its body is an ENORMOUS FLAT ALMOST PERFECTLY CIRCULAR DISC - as tall as it is long, round like a dinner plate or a wheel, hugely deep and rounded, NOT elongated, NOT torpedo-shaped, NOT oval. From the top and bottom of this disc rise TWO ENORMOUS TALL POINTED FINS, one straight up and one straight down, together nearly as tall as the body is wide. It has NO REAL TAIL - the back of the disc simply ends in a short frilled scalloped rudder. Rough mottled silver-grey skin, a tiny round mouth, one large round eye, small pectoral fins
kiwi: A kiwi bird standing on two legs in side view. ITS BODY IS SHAPED LIKE AN AVOCADO OR A TEARDROP - a plump rounded pear-shaped mass, broadest and heaviest at the rear and NARROWING SMOOTHLY FORWARD INTO A SHORT NECK AND A SMALL POINTED HEAD, with no distinct join between body and head. It must NOT be a broad flat-backed round-bodied bird and NOT be shaped like a dodo. NO VISIBLE WINGS AT ALL. Its feathers look like coarse shaggy BROWN HAIR rather than plumage. An EXTREMELY LONG SLENDER PALE BILL, straight and thin, half again as long as its head. Tiny black eyes, short pale whiskers at the base of the bill, thick stubby legs with three strong toes
ringedcaecilian: A ringed caecilian, a LIMBLESS soil-dwelling amphibian that looks like a large earthworm. IT HAS ABSOLUTELY NO LIMBS - NO legs, NO arms, NO feet, NO flippers, NO stubs, NOTHING projecting from its body anywhere along its length. Its body is one smooth glossy dark blue-grey tube of even thickness, RINGED ALONG ITS WHOLE LENGTH BY MANY EVENLY SPACED PALE CREAM GROOVES that encircle it like the segments of a worm. A blunt rounded head with a tiny mouth and vestigial eyes covered by skin. Coiled in a loose curve
firebird: A firebird, a magnificent bird with brilliant orange, scarlet and gold plumage that glows like hot embers, its long tail feathers streaming behind it in trailing plumes of flame. Its wings are spread wide and fire flickers along the edges of its feathers. THE BACKGROUND IS COMPLETELY EMPTY AND UNIFORM - there must be NO CIRCLE, NO DISC, NO RING, NO HALO, NO GLOWING ORB, NO SUN AND NO PALE SHAPE OF ANY KIND behind the bird. Nothing at all behind it, only flat empty background, with the bird alone on it
grootslang: A grootslang, a creature with EXACTLY TWO PARTS AND NO OTHERS: THE HEAD OF AN ELEPHANT joined directly to THE LONG BODY OF AN ENORMOUS SNAKE. The head is a grey elephant's head with a trunk, two tusks and wide ears. Behind the head there is NOTHING BUT SNAKE: one immense scaled serpent body coiling away in heavy loops, dark grey-green, thick as a tree trunk, tapering to a tail. IT HAS NO LEGS, NO ARMS, NO FEET, NO CLAWS, NO ELEPHANT BODY AND NO WINGS - no limbs of any kind anywhere. An elephant's head on a snake, nothing more
bixi: A bixi, a mythical Chinese tortoise-dragon carrying a heavy stone tablet on its back. ITS HEAD IS THE HEAD OF A CHINESE DRAGON, NOT A TORTOISE'S HEAD: a broad scaled reptilian dragon head with bulging round eyes, flaring nostrils on a blunt snout, a fringed beard and whiskers trailing from its jaw, a pair of FORKED ANTLER-LIKE HORNS swept back over its skull, and a mane of flowing hair behind them. Its body is a massive tortoise with a domed ridged shell and four thick clawed legs. Weathered stone-grey and jade-green
puca: A puca, a supernatural black HARE - a hare, not a horse and not a rabbit - standing alert on four legs in side view with its head turned toward the viewer. A large lean long-limbed hare with VERY LONG BLACK-TIPPED EARS held upright, powerful long hind legs, and a lean rangy body. Its fur is deep midnight black with a faint blue sheen, and its eyes glow a bright unnatural GOLD. An eerie uncanny air, as though it is about to speak
fairy: A fairy of Irish folklore, one of the Aos Si - a slender pale humanoid figure standing tall and proud, NOT a small cute cartoon pixie. A graceful adult figure in a flowing pale grey-green robe, with long silver-white hair, sharply pointed ears, and cool luminous eyes with an aloof haughty expression. A faint cold silver glow outlines her. Behind her shoulders rise TWO PAIRS OF LONG NARROW TRANSLUCENT WINGS, veined like a dragonfly's and faintly iridescent. Elegant, otherworldly and slightly unsettling
